text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, I need to check if you have noticed pale or clay-colored stools, and if the itching is worse at night. Also, have you had any recent episodes of diarrhea or blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, the presence of scleral icterus, and severe pruritus, I suspect primary sclerosing cholangitis. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel, Alkaline_Phosphatase, MRCP
